会员模块数据库设计文档 - 多商户多门店版

<blockquote>
<p data-track="17"><span style="background-color: initial">&nbsp;<strong><span style="font-size: 18px">会员模块数据库设计文档 - 多商户多门店版</span></strong></span></p>

<p data-track="17"><span style="font-size: 18px"><strong>宠辱不惊，闲看庭前花开花落；去留无意，漫随天外云卷云舒</strong></span>。</p>
<p data-track="17">&nbsp;</p>
<p data-track="17">&nbsp;</p>
</blockquote>
<div class="container">
<h1>🏷️ 会员模块数据库设计文档</h1>
<div class="subtitle">支持多商户·多门店·实物卡·储值消费·积分体系·余额重算 · MySQL 8.0+</div>
<div class="meta-info"><span>📅 版本：<strong>v3.0 (多商户版)</strong></span> <span>📁 数据库：<strong>MySQL 8.0</strong></span> <span>🧩 字符集：<strong>utf8mb4</strong></span> <span>📐 金额精度：<strong>分 (BIGINT)</strong></span> <span>📋 表数量：<strong>10 张</strong></span> <span>🏢 支持：<strong>多商户 + 多门店</strong></span></div>

<h2>📖 概述</h2>
<p>本数据库设计面向 <strong>多商户多门店会员卡管理系统</strong>，支持 <strong>实物卡（芯片ID）</strong> 与 <strong>无卡消费（手机号）</strong> 两种场景。 核心能力包括：储值充值、折扣消费、积分累积与兑换、余额变动全链路日志、<strong>余额重算</strong> 机制，以及 <strong>多商户/门店数据隔离</strong>。 设计时已预留 <strong>计次卡</strong> 扩展能力。</p>
<div class="note-box note-box-success"><strong>🏢 多商户多门店支持：</strong> 所有会员表已增加 <code>fk_company_id</code> 和 <code>fk_store_id</code> 字段，实现数据隔离。 每个商户/门店可独立配置积分规则、折扣比例、充值策略等。</div>

<div class="note-box note-box-info"><strong>🆕 本次新增/变更：</strong>
<ul style="margin-top: 8px; padding-left: 20px">
<li><strong>新增</strong> <code>fk_company_id</code>、<code>fk_store_id</code> 字段到所有会员表</li>
<li><strong>新增</strong> <code>member_merchant_config</code> 表 - 商户/门店级别配置</li>
<li><strong>新增</strong> <code>member_operation_log</code> 表 - 操作审计日志</li>
<li><strong>统一</strong> 所有表增加公用字段：<code>key_id</code>、<code>sort_index</code>、<code>create_by</code>、<code>create_time</code>、<code>update_by</code>、<code>update_time</code></li>
<li><strong>新增</strong> <code>v_member_card_full</code> 视图 - 关联商户门店信息</li>
</ul>
</div>

<h2>📋 表结构详细设计</h2>

<div class="note-box note-box-success"><strong>🏢 多商户关键字段：</strong> <code>fk_company_id</code> 和 <code>fk_store_id</code> 实现数据隔离， 查询时务必带上这两个条件，确保不同商户/门店数据互不干扰。</div>

<h3>3. member_consume <span class="badge">消费明细表</span></h3>
<div class="table-grid">
<table>
<thead>
<tr><th style="width: 16%">字段</th><th style="width: 20%">类型</th><th style="width: 8%">空</th><th style="width: 10%">键</th><th style="width: 46%">说明</th></tr>

<h3>10. v_member_card_full <span class="badge badge-store">📊 会员卡完整信息视图</span></h3>
<div class="code-block"><span class="sql-comment">-- 关联商户和门店信息的完整视图</span> CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW <span class="sql-table">v_member_card_full</span> AS SELECT mc.key_id, mc.card_no, mc.chip_id, mc.phone, mc.card_type, mc.status, mc.current_balance, mc.current_principal, mc.current_gift, mc.current_points, mc.discount_rate, mc.open_date, mc.expire_date, mc.last_consume_time, <span class="sql-comment">-- 商户信息</span> sm.company_fullname AS company_name, sm.company_shortname AS company_shortname, sm.contact_info AS company_contact, sm.contact_phone AS company_phone, <span class="sql-comment">-- 门店信息</span> sms.name AS store_name, sms.store_no, sms.phone AS store_phone, sms.address AS store_address, sms.contact AS store_contact, <span class="sql-comment">-- 配置信息</span> COALESCE(mmc_store.gift_consume_ratio, mmc_company.gift_consume_ratio, sys1.config_value) AS gift_consume_ratio, COALESCE(mmc_store.points_rate, mmc_company.points_rate, sys2.config_value) AS points_rate, COALESCE(mmc_store.points_exchange_rate, mmc_company.points_exchange_rate, sys3.config_value) AS points_exchange_rate FROM member_card mc LEFT JOIN sauna_merchant sm ON mc.fk_company_id = sm.key_id LEFT JOIN sauna_merchant_store sms ON mc.fk_store_id = sms.key_id LEFT JOIN member_merchant_config mmc_store ON mc.fk_store_id = mmc_store.fk_store_id AND mmc_store.is_enabled = 1 LEFT JOIN member_merchant_config mmc_company ON mc.fk_company_id = mmc_company.fk_company_id AND mmc_company.fk_store_id IS NULL AND mmc_company.is_enabled = 1 LEFT JOIN system_consume_config sys1 ON sys1.config_key = 'gift_consume_ratio' LEFT JOIN system_consume_config sys2 ON sys2.config_key = 'points_rate' LEFT JOIN system_consume_config sys3 ON sys3.config_key = 'points_exchange_rate';</div>

<h2>⚙️ 核心建表SQL（完整）</h2>
<div class="code-block"><span class="sql-comment">-- ======================================================</span> <span class="sql-comment">-- 1. 会员卡主表（支持多商户多门店）</span> <span class="sql-comment">-- ======================================================</span> CREATE TABLE <span class="sql-table">member_card</span> ( <span class="sql-keyword">id</span> BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '主键ID', <span class="sql-keyword">key_id</span> VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL COMMENT '业务主键ID', <span class="sql-keyword">card_no</span> VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL COMMENT '会员卡编号', <span class="sql-keyword">chip_id</span> VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL COMMENT '芯片ID唯一码', <span class="sql-keyword">phone</span> VARCHAR(11) NOT NULL COMMENT '绑定手机号', <span class="sql-keyword">fk_company_id</span> VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL COMMENT '所属公司ID', <span class="sql-keyword">fk_store_id</span> VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL COMMENT '所属门店ID', <span class="sql-keyword">card_type</span> TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 COMMENT '卡类型:1-储值卡,2-计次卡', <span class="sql-keyword">status</span> TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 COMMENT '状态:0-冻结,1-正常,2-挂失,3-注销', <span class="sql-keyword">total_recharge</span> BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '累计充值金额', <span class="sql-keyword">total_gift</span> BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '累计赠送金额', <span class="sql-keyword">total_consume</span> BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '累计消费本金', <span class="sql-keyword">total_gift_consume</span> BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '累计赠送消费', <span class="sql-keyword">current_balance</span> BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '当前可用总余额', <span class="sql-keyword">current_principal</span> BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '当前本金余额', <span class="sql-keyword">current_gift</span> BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '当前赠送余额', <span class="sql-keyword">total_points</span> INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '累计获得积分', <span class="sql-keyword">used_points</span> INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '已使用积分', <span class="sql-keyword">current_points</span> INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '当前可用积分', <span class="sql-keyword">discount_rate</span> DECIMAL(5,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 100.00 COMMENT '折扣比例', <span class="sql-keyword">open_date</span> DATETIME NOT NULL COMMENT '开卡日期', <span class="sql-keyword">expire_date</span> DATETIME DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '有效期', <span class="sql-keyword">last_consume_time</span> DATETIME DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '最后消费时间', <span class="sql-keyword">sort_index</span> INT DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '排序码', <span class="sql-keyword">create_by</span> VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '创建人', <span class="sql-keyword">create_time</span> DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '创建时间', <span class="sql-keyword">update_by</span> VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '修改人', <span class="sql-keyword">update_time</span> DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '修改时间', PRIMARY KEY (<span class="sql-keyword">id</span>), UNIQUE KEY <span class="sql-keyword">uk_key_id</span> (<span class="sql-keyword">key_id</span>), UNIQUE KEY <span class="sql-keyword">uk_card_no</span> (<span class="sql-keyword">card_no</span>), UNIQUE KEY <span class="sql-keyword">uk_chip_id</span> (<span class="sql-keyword">chip_id</span>), KEY <span class="sql-keyword">idx_phone</span> (<span class="sql-keyword">phone</span>), KEY <span class="sql-keyword">idx_company_store</span> (<span class="sql-keyword">fk_company_id</span>, <span class="sql-keyword">fk_store_id</span>), KEY <span class="sql-keyword">idx_status</span> (<span class="sql-keyword">status</span>), KEY <span class="sql-keyword">idx_create_time</span> (<span class="sql-keyword">create_time</span>) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COMMENT='会员卡主表'; <span class="sql-comment">-- ======================================================</span> <span class="sql-comment">-- 2. 会员开卡/充值记录表</span> <span class="sql-comment">-- ======================================================</span> CREATE TABLE <span class="sql-table">member_recharge</span> ( <span class="sql-keyword">id</span> BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, <span class="sql-keyword">key_id</span> VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL COMMENT '业务主键ID', <span class="sql-keyword">card_id</span> BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL COMMENT '会员卡自增ID', <span class="sql-keyword">card_key_id</span> VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL COMMENT '会员卡业务ID', <span class="sql-keyword">recharge_no</span> VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL COMMENT '充值流水号', <span class="sql-keyword">recharge_type</span> TINYINT NOT NULL COMMENT '类型:1-开卡,2-充值,3-赠送活动,4-手动调账', <span class="sql-keyword">amount</span> BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '充值金额(本金)', <span class="sql-keyword">gift_amount</span> BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '赠送金额', <span class="sql-keyword">pay_method</span> TINYINT DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '支付方式', <span class="sql-keyword">operator_id</span> VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '操作人员ID', <span class="sql-keyword">remark</span> VARCHAR(255) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '备注', <span class="sql-keyword">recharge_time</span> DATETIME NOT NULL COMMENT '充值时间', <span class="sql-keyword">sort_index</span> INT DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '排序码', <span class="sql-keyword">create_by</span> VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '创建人', <span class="sql-keyword">create_time</span> DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '创建时间', <span class="sql-keyword">update_by</span> VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '修改人', <span class="sql-keyword">update_time</span> DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '修改时间', PRIMARY KEY (<span class="sql-keyword">id</span>), UNIQUE KEY <span class="sql-keyword">uk_key_id</span> (<span class="sql-keyword">key_id</span>), UNIQUE KEY <span class="sql-keyword">uk_recharge_no</span> (<span class="sql-keyword">recharge_no</span>), KEY <span class="sql-keyword">idx_card_id</span> (<span class="sql-keyword">card_id</span>), KEY <span class="sql-keyword">idx_card_key_id</span> (<span class="sql-keyword">card_key_id</span>), KEY <span class="sql-keyword">idx_recharge_time</span> (<span class="sql-keyword">recharge_time</span>), KEY <span class="sql-keyword">idx_create_time</span> (<span class="sql-keyword">create_time</span>) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COMMENT='充值/开卡记录表'; <span class="sql-comment">-- ... 其余表结构请参见文档上方详细字段说明 ...</span></div>

<h2>🧠 核心业务逻辑</h2>
<div class="flow-grid">
<div class="flow-card">
<h4>💰 消费扣款流程</h4>
<ul>
<li><span class="tag">1</span> 获取商户/门店配置的 <code>gift_consume_ratio</code></li>
<li><span class="tag">2</span> 根据比例计算赠送扣款金额</li>
<li><span class="tag">3</span> 优先扣除赠送金额，不足时从本金补扣</li>
<li><span class="tag">4</span> 按实际扣款金额计算积分</li>
<li><span class="tag">5</span> 记录 <code>member_consume</code> 明细</li>
<li><span class="tag">6</span> 同步更新 <code>member_card</code> 余额</li>
<li><span class="tag">7</span> 写入 <code>member_balance_log</code> 变动日志</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div class="flow-card">
<h4>🔄 余额重算流程</h4>
<ul>
<li><span class="tag">1</span> 根据 <code>recharge</code> + <code>consume</code> 重新计算</li>
<li><span class="tag">2</span> 对比当前余额，计算差异</li>
<li><span class="tag">3</span> 更新 <code>member_card</code> 为正确余额</li>
<li><span class="tag">4</span> 记录 <code>member_balance_recalc</code> 重算审计</li>
<li><span class="tag">5</span> 在 <code>member_balance_log</code> 中插入修正记录</li>
<li><span class="tag">6</span> 标记相关日志 <code>is_recalculated = 1</code></li>
</ul>
</div>
<div class="flow-card">
<h4>🏢 多商户数据隔离</h4>
<ul>
<li><span class="tag tag-green">•</span> 所有查询必须带 <code>fk_company_id</code></li>
<li><span class="tag tag-green">•</span> 门店级查询额外带 <code>fk_store_id</code></li>
<li><span class="tag tag-green">•</span> 配置优先级：门店 &gt; 公司 &gt; 系统</li>
<li><span class="tag tag-green">•</span> 支持跨门店会员（公司级统一管理）</li>
<li><span class="tag tag-green">•</span> 每个商户独立积分/折扣规则</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div class="flow-card">
<h4>📱 无卡消费 + 审计</h4>
<ul>
<li><span class="tag">•</span> 通过 <code>phone</code> 字段查询会员</li>
<li><span class="tag">•</span> 支持手机号+验证码身份验证</li>
<li><span class="tag">•</span> 所有操作记录 <code>member_operation_log</code></li>
<li><span class="tag">•</span> 记录操作前后数据快照（JSON）</li>
<li><span class="tag">•</span> 支持操作追溯和问题排查</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>

<h2>🚀 扩展性设计</h2>
<div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr)); gap: 16px; margin: 16px 0 24px">
<div style="background: rgba(240, 253, 244, 1); padding: 16px 20px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(187, 247, 208, 1)"><span class="badge-green">✓ 计次卡</span>
<div style="font-size: 14px; color: rgba(75, 85, 99, 1); margin-top: 6px">card_type=2，可增加次卡消费记录表</div>
</div>
<div style="background: rgba(239, 246, 255, 1); padding: 16px 20px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(191, 219, 254, 1)"><span class="badge-blue">✓ 多支付方式</span>
<div style="font-size: 14px; color: rgba(75, 85, 99, 1); margin-top: 6px">pay_method 字段支持扩展</div>
</div>
<div style="background: rgba(254, 243, 199, 1); padding: 16px 20px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(252, 211, 77, 1)"><span class="badge-orange">✓ 活动赠送</span>
<div style="font-size: 14px; color: rgba(75, 85, 99, 1); margin-top: 6px">recharge_type=3 支持满赠活动</div>
</div>
<div style="background: rgba(252, 231, 243, 1); padding: 16px 20px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(249, 168, 212, 1)"><span class="badge" style="background: rgba(219, 39, 119, 1)">✓ 多级折扣</span>
<div style="font-size: 14px; color: rgba(75, 85, 99, 1); margin-top: 6px">discount_rate 支持不同等级折扣</div>
</div>
<div style="background: rgba(224, 242, 254, 1); padding: 16px 20px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(186, 230, 253, 1)"><span class="badge-blue">✓ 商户独立配置</span>
<div style="font-size: 14px; color: rgba(75, 85, 99, 1); margin-top: 6px">member_merchant_config 支持各商户独立规则</div>
</div>
<div style="background: rgba(237, 233, 254, 1); padding: 16px 20px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(196, 181, 253, 1)"><span class="badge" style="background: rgba(124, 58, 237, 1)">✓ 完整审计</span>
<div style="font-size: 14px; color: rgba(75, 85, 99, 1); margin-top: 6px">member_operation_log 记录所有操作</div>
</div>
</div>

<h2>📌 索引优化建议</h2>
<div class="code-block"><span class="sql-comment">-- 多商户查询优化索引</span> CREATE INDEX <span class="sql-keyword">idx_company_store</span> ON member_card(fk_company_id, fk_store_id); CREATE INDEX <span class="sql-keyword">idx_company_store_status</span> ON member_card(fk_company_id, fk_store_id, status); CREATE INDEX <span class="sql-keyword">idx_company_store_time</span> ON member_card(fk_company_id, fk_store_id, create_time); <span class="sql-comment">-- 余额日志查询优化</span> CREATE INDEX <span class="sql-keyword">idx_balance_log_card_time</span> ON member_balance_log(card_key_id, create_time DESC); CREATE INDEX <span class="sql-keyword">idx_balance_log_company</span> ON member_balance_log(card_key_id, create_time DESC); <span class="sql-comment">-- 消费记录优化</span> CREATE INDEX <span class="sql-keyword">idx_consume_card_time</span> ON member_consume(card_key_id, consume_time DESC); CREATE INDEX <span class="sql-keyword">idx_consume_company_time</span> ON member_consume(card_key_id, consume_time DESC); <span class="sql-comment">-- 操作日志查询</span> CREATE INDEX <span class="sql-keyword">idx_oplog_card_time</span> ON member_operation_log(card_key_id, operation_time DESC); CREATE INDEX <span class="sql-keyword">idx_oplog_type_time</span> ON member_operation_log(operation_type, operation_time DESC);</div>

<h2>📊 枚举值说明</h2>
<div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 16px; margin: 16px 0 30px; font-size: 14px">
<div style="background: rgba(248, 250, 252, 1); padding: 16px 20px; border-radius: 10px"><strong>card_type</strong>
<div style="color: rgba(75, 85, 99, 1); margin-top: 4px">1-储值卡，2-计次卡</div>
</div>
<div style="background: rgba(248, 250, 252, 1); padding: 16px 20px; border-radius: 10px"><strong>status</strong>
<div style="color: rgba(75, 85, 99, 1); margin-top: 4px">0-冻结，1-正常，2-挂失，3-注销</div>
</div>
<div style="background: rgba(248, 250, 252, 1); padding: 16px 20px; border-radius: 10px"><strong>recharge_type</strong>
<div style="color: rgba(75, 85, 99, 1); margin-top: 4px">1-开卡，2-充值，3-赠送活动，4-手动调账</div>
</div>
<div style="background: rgba(248, 250, 252, 1); padding: 16px 20px; border-radius: 10px"><strong>change_type (balance_log)</strong>
<div style="color: rgba(75, 85, 99, 1); margin-top: 4px">1-开卡，2-充值，3-消费，4-退款，5-手动调整，6-积分兑换，7-重算修正</div>
</div>
<div style="background: rgba(248, 250, 252, 1); padding: 16px 20px; border-radius: 10px"><strong>exchange_type</strong>
<div style="color: rgba(75, 85, 99, 1); margin-top: 4px">1-抵现，2-兑换礼品，3-兑换优惠券</div>
</div>
<div style="background: rgba(248, 250, 252, 1); padding: 16px 20px; border-radius: 10px"><strong>pay_method</strong>
<div style="color: rgba(75, 85, 99, 1); margin-top: 4px">1-现金，2-微信，3-支付宝，4-银行卡</div>
</div>
<div style="background: rgba(248, 250, 252, 1); padding: 16px 20px; border-radius: 10px"><strong>config_type</strong>
<div style="color: rgba(75, 85, 99, 1); margin-top: 4px">1-公司级，2-门店级</div>
</div>
<div style="background: rgba(248, 250, 252, 1); padding: 16px 20px; border-radius: 10px"><strong>operation_type</strong>
<div style="color: rgba(75, 85, 99, 1); margin-top: 4px">1-开卡，2-充值，3-消费，4-冻结，5-解冻，6-挂失，7-解挂，8-注销，9-余额调整，10-积分调整</div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="note-box" style="background: rgba(240, 244, 255, 1); border-left-color: rgba(79, 70, 229, 1); color: rgba(30, 27, 75, 1)"><strong>📌 重要设计原则：</strong>
<ul style="margin-top: 8px; padding-left: 20px; color: rgba(30, 27, 75, 1)">
<li>所有金额字段以 <strong>「分」</strong> 为单位存储（BIGINT），避免浮点数精度问题</li>
<li>余额变动 <strong>必须</strong> 记录 <code>member_balance_log</code>，且记录变动前后完整快照</li>
<li>重算操作 <strong>必须</strong> 记录 <code>member_balance_recalc</code>，并标记相关日志</li>
<li><strong>多商户查询务必带上 <code>fk_company_id</code></strong>，确保数据隔离</li>
<li>建议使用 <strong>数据库事务</strong> 保证充值/消费/日志写入的原子性</li>
<li><code>key_id</code> 作为业务主键，推荐使用 <code>REPLACE(UUID(), '-', '')</code> 生成</li>
</ul>
</div>

<h2>💻 C# 实体类示例</h2>
<div class="code-block" style="max-height: 400px"><span class="sql-comment">// MemberCard.cs - 会员卡实体</span> <span class="sql-keyword">namespace</span> ZR.Model.Merchant { [SugarTable(<span class="sql-string">"member_card"</span>)] <span class="sql-keyword">public class</span> MemberCard { [SugarColumn(IsPrimaryKey = true, IsIdentity = false, ColumnName = <span class="sql-string">"key_id"</span>)] <span class="sql-keyword">public string</span> KeyId { get; <span class="sql-keyword">get</span>; <span class="sql-keyword">set</span>; } [SugarColumn(ColumnName = <span class="sql-string">"fk_company_id"</span>)] <span class="sql-keyword">public string</span> FkCompanyId { get; <span class="sql-keyword">get</span>; <span class="sql-keyword">set</span>; } [SugarColumn(ColumnName = <span class="sql-string">"fk_store_id"</span>)] <span class="sql-keyword">public string</span> FkStoreId { get; <span class="sql-keyword">get</span>; <span class="sql-keyword">set</span>; } [SugarColumn(ColumnName = <span class="sql-string">"card_no"</span>)] <span class="sql-keyword">public string</span> CardNo { get; <span class="sql-keyword">get</span>; <span class="sql-keyword">set</span>; } [SugarColumn(ColumnName = <span class="sql-string">"chip_id"</span>)] <span class="sql-keyword">public string</span> ChipId { get; <span class="sql-keyword">get</span>; <span class="sql-keyword">set</span>; } <span class="sql-keyword">public string</span> Phone { get; <span class="sql-keyword">get</span>; <span class="sql-keyword">set</span>; } [SugarColumn(ColumnName = <span class="sql-string">"current_principal"</span>)] <span class="sql-keyword">public long</span> CurrentPrincipal { get; <span class="sql-keyword">get</span>; <span class="sql-keyword">set</span>; } [SugarColumn(ColumnName = <span class="sql-string">"current_gift"</span>)] <span class="sql-keyword">public long</span> CurrentGift { get; <span class="sql-keyword">get</span>; <span class="sql-keyword">set</span>; } [SugarColumn(ColumnName = <span class="sql-string">"current_points"</span>)] <span class="sql-keyword">public int</span> CurrentPoints { get; <span class="sql-keyword">get</span>; <span class="sql-keyword">set</span>; } <span class="sql-comment">// 公用字段</span> [SugarColumn(ColumnName = <span class="sql-string">"sort_index"</span>)] <span class="sql-keyword">public int?</span> SortIndex { get; <span class="sql-keyword">get</span>; <span class="sql-keyword">set</span>; } [SugarColumn(ColumnName = <span class="sql-string">"create_by"</span>)] <span class="sql-keyword">public string</span> CreateBy { get; <span class="sql-keyword">get</span>; <span class="sql-keyword">set</span>; } [SugarColumn(ColumnName = <span class="sql-string">"create_time"</span>)] <span class="sql-keyword">public DateTime?</span> CreateTime { get; <span class="sql-keyword">get</span>; <span class="sql-keyword">set</span>; } [SugarColumn(ColumnName = <span class="sql-string">"update_by"</span>)] <span class="sql-keyword">public string</span> UpdateBy { get; <span class="sql-keyword">get</span>; <span class="sql-keyword">set</span>; } [SugarColumn(ColumnName = <span class="sql-string">"update_time"</span>)] <span class="sql-keyword">public DateTime?</span> UpdateTime { get; <span class="sql-keyword">get</span>; <span class="sql-keyword">set</span>; } } }</div>
